problem: Current AI systems and research often overlook the impact of generative AI on human cognitive capabilities by conflating performed and demonstrated critical thinking (p.1, p.2).
methodology: This is a position paper that proposes a distinction between performed and demonstrated critical thinking, drawing insights from Douglas Engelbart's intellect augmentation framework and educational research (p.1-4).
key_findings: The paper distinguishes between performed critical thinking (cognitive processes undertaken independently of AI) and demonstrated critical thinking (processes or products occurring with AI assistance) (p.1-2). Current AI systems and interaction paradigms may enhance demonstrated critical thinking, but they do not necessarily improve performed critical thinking (p.2).
title: Designing AI Systems that Augment Human Performed vs. Demonstrated Critical Thinking
